source_review.backup_continuation: Both prior backups must exist; backup binary must match fixed original hash; backup manifest SHA must equal current original manifest SHA. Current installed binary and manifest already checked against old identity/hash. Mismatch/one missing aborts. Matching existing backups are not overwritten.
source_review.wait_order: Original service PID Process object acquired before stop; SafeHandle explicitly opened before Stop-Service; then SCM Stopped wait and bounded WaitForExit(15000); only successful completion proceeds to executable replacement. Dispose runs even if stop/wait throws.
source_review.timeout_and_handle_failure: These occur before replacement try block: no replacement or manifest change is attempted. Stop/exit timeout may leave old service stopped or stopping; backups and private data remain preserved for diagnosis.
source_review.rollback: Replacement/start failure retains previous rule: rollback only if SCM Stopped and backup old hash matches. Status/configuration failures after successful start retain repaired binary and backups. No claim of atomic rollback.
source_review.scope: Script-only final diff; binary unchanged from prior independent review. No private file deletion, overwrite, marker reset, formal start, provider call, service account/config change, or arbitrary process termination.
